name: BI Norwegian Business School
summary: Private business school in Oslo; three English bachelor's in business, data science and digital business, with rolling admission after 1 March.

ib.text: IB Diploma; English A at grade 3 or English B at grade 5. Still in your final year? Apply on official predicted grades and give BI access to your results through the IBO.

dates.label: Priority deadline for international applicants; rolling admission after

programmes.name: Bachelor in Business Administration (BBA)
programmes.about: A broad business degree in management, marketing, operations, accounting and finance, taught with students from over 60 countries; in year three you specialise in Finance, International Business or Shipping Management.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma with English A at 3 or English B at 5, plus a one-page motivation letter and a CV. Good maths is recommended, not required.
programmes.selectionNote: Qualified applications by the 1 March priority deadline are handled first, then rolling admission while places last. BI publishes no places or ranking rule.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Data Science for Business
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Data Science for Business
programmes.ib: Any IB maths (AA or AI, SL or HL) at grade 3 or better; otherwise pass the OMPT-F maths test with 60%.
programmes.about: Business subjects (accounting, economics, finance, management) joined to statistics, machine learning and Python programming for data analysis and visualisation, with a course in AI and data ethics.

needs.note: No IB maths? Pass BI's OMPT-F maths test with 60% (two attempts).

programmes.selectionNote: Qualified applications by the 1 March priority deadline are handled first, then rolling admission while places last. BI publishes no places or ranking rule.

programmes.name: Bachelor in Digital Business
programmes.about: Digital innovation, AI, automation and cloud solutions studied alongside economics, marketing, strategy and leadership, with project work on real problems and courses such as low-code software development and digital business law.
programmes.ib: IB Diploma with English A at 3 or English B at 5, plus a one-page motivation letter and a CV. Good maths is recommended, not required.
programmes.selectionNote: Qualified applications by the 1 March priority deadline are handled first, then rolling admission while places last. BI publishes no places or ranking rule.

notes: BI is private, so EU/EEA students pay tuition too: NOK 106,400 a year, invoiced each semester and adjusted annually.
Tick “I will upload my final diploma later” when you apply, so you can meet the 1 March priority deadline before your IB results.
Applications also ask for a one-page motivation letter, a CV and a financial plan.
